name: GameTechDev/ISPCTextureCompressor
description: Intel ISPC-based texture compression library supporting BC6H, BC7, ASTC, ETC1, and BC4/BC5 formats using SIMD CPU optimization for high-speed offline compression.
score_rationale: Historically useful SIMD texture compressor with 470 stars, but archived by Intel in September 2024 with no further maintenance planned.
summary: Intel ISPC SIMD texture compressor for BC/ASTC/ETC formats offline
